iti109:1.1: vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā. vuttamarahatā’ti me sutaṃ:
iti109:2.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, puriso nadiyā sotena ovuyheyya piyarūpasātarūpena.
iti109:2.2: tamenaṃ cakkhumā puriso tīre ṭhito disvā evaṃ vadeyya,
iti109:2.3: ‘kiñcāpi kho tvaṃ ambho purisa nadiyā sotena ovuyhasi piyarūpasātarūpena, atthi cettha heṭṭhā rahado saūmi sāvaṭṭo sagaho sarakkhaso yaṃ tvaṃ ambho purisa, pāpuṇitvā maraṇaṃ vā nigacchasi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhanti.”
iti109:2.4: atha kho so bhikkhave puriso tassa purisassa saddaṃ sutvā hatthehi ca pādehi ca paṭisotaṃ vāyameyya.
iti109:3.1: upamā kho me ayaṃ bhikkhave katā atthassa viññāpanāya.
iti109:3.3: nadiyā soto’ti kho bhikkhave, taṇhāyetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
iti109:4.1: piyarūpasātarūpanti kho bhikkhave channetaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
iti109:5.1: heṭṭhārahado’ti kho bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
iti109:7.1: sāvaṭṭo’ti kho bhikkhave pañcannetaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
iti109:8.1: sagaho sarakkhaso’ti kho bhikkhave mātugāmassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
iti109:10.1: hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyāmo’ti kho bhikkhave, viriyārambhassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
iti109:11.1: cakkhumā puriso tīre ṭhito’ti kho bhikkhave, tathāgatassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassāti.
iti109:13.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.
